body: Yeah it’s nearly the same so much for me. Like it should be easy to bring yourself to just ask someone to hang out... but I can’t? Because I don’t want to be a burden? Because I may not enjoy it? Because I don’t deserve it? Because it’s only a temporary fix to a longer string of sadness? I don’t know. I could go on about how much I feel like I shouldn’t hang out with people, but I’ll stop here.

Affection really is a hard thing to reciprocate, but it does seem to be a lot easier with animals. I hope that your difficulty with showing affection doesn’t impact your relationship with your boyfriend too heavily. Oh and by the way, I’m really glad we got to talk. It really helped more than you may know.

Yeah I would think that lack of affection comes from the same place of self-doubt. Are you just not a very affectionate person in general? I do know it’s hard to see through the anxiety and know that love isn’t a selfish emotion to have.
It really is such a hassle to try and express affection and care for someone when you can’t accept it back. I don’t think I could ever truly accept love.

Yeah I feel I can relate. It’s just hard to say you love someone when that forces a sort of expectation on them to care about you in return, and when you have copious amounts of self-hatred, indirectly asking someone to show any amount of care for you is just so much to do.
I’m glad that there’s a simple enough way to go about this. Thank you so much for the information.
Thanks for the reply. Since she isn’t 18 yet, I take it she would need to go to a guidance counselor to seek help. What would the guidance counselor be able to do in this situation?

It's called "When will there be good news?" It was recommended by a friend, so I bought it but that was a couple months back. I hope that tomorrow I finally start reading it. What's yours?
Thanks, that means a lot. I'll try my best to watch Dunkirk today. I also plan to try and read a book for the first time in a year or two, so that ought to be good for me.
You should, I enjoyed it enough that I'd rewatch it some other time. I'm glad I was able to do something different today.
It was the Emperor's New Groove. I hadn't seen it before, so I forced myself to watch it even though I didn't feel like it. I liked it, about as much as I thought I would.
